title: Every-fixed-original-point-map direct D6 quenched lower at least s^6/8
statement: For every s=2^h>=8 and EVERY fixed complete original globally injected point map f, with physical alphabet a minimal and K=C(a,2), V=(s+1)(s^2+1), m=K-V, the occupied left connected C6 count is bounded below by C_s=(a)_6/12 - m(a-2)_4>0. At least C_s(s+1)_6 genuine original Q have distinct original points/lines and physical left C6. Therefore E_g D6(f,g) >= ((a)_6/(K)_6) * C_s * (s+1)_6 >= s^6/8, with g a SINGLE uniformly random full globally injected line map. Hence min_f max_g S_s(f,g)>=s^6/8; not min_(f,g)S_s.

quantifiers.domain: any fixed complete original point globally injected unordered physical-pair map
one independently uniformly sampled COMPLETE globally injected original line physical-pair map, shared across ALL original Q

external_dependencies: Minimal physical-pair alphabet leaves m<=a-2 unoccupied edges; deletion union bound for simple K_a cycles.
True GQ original source incidence degree s+1; distinct-line SDR count at least (s+1)_6.
Finite integer-rational cases s=8,16,32,64,128 plus analytic estimates s>=256 as pinned in PR480 proof.
limitations: The probabilistic statement does not control adversarially jointly selected f,g.
The bound certifies direct seven-positive original D6 expected charge, not full GF5 R3/ASET exponents.
Positive expectation does not imply D6>0 for all fixed g or stochastic concentration.
falsification_boundary: Do not replace minimal physical pair alphabet with arbitrary a or source incidence Q with physical paths. Only h>=3; finite small h cases do not inherit bound as stated.
